filtering_rules: Reject missing recipe_id, title, valid http(s) recipe_url, parsed ingredients, or parsed directions.
Reject missing, non-finite, or negative core nutrition values.
Reject sodium, protein, fiber, or total fat values above configured per-serving thresholds.
When food_only is enabled, reject non_food and pet_food recipe-like records and retain ambiguous records.
Keep health_score unresolved; preserve HUMMUS who_score, fsa_score, and nutri_score.
food_only_filter_rules: Classify pet_food when strong title, description, direction, ingredient, or tag evidence identifies dogs/cats/pets as the intended consumer.
Classify non_food when a high-confidence non-food title phrase is present, unless protected food/beverage evidence applies.
Classify non_food when non-food action/use phrases are present without strong food-positive evidence.
Classify soap records as non_food only when soap/cosmetic context is present and no protected food/beverage evidence applies.
Retain ambiguous_requires_review records; do not reject them during automatic filtering.
Protect ambiguous human-food titles such as corn dog, hot dog, chili dog, hush puppies, puppy chow, Polish sausage, Bisi Bela Bath, Salty Dog cocktails, and restaurant/person-name dog/cat terms.
Do not reject incidental pet references inside otherwise human recipes, such as using discarded scraps in dog food.
known_limitations: No explicit preparation-time/cooking-time split; duration is total time.
No recipe image URLs in pp_recipes.csv.
Selected recipe membership and ordering are deterministic for the same source/rules/seed, but timestamps make full manifest bytes differ across runs.
license_use_notes: Food.com data may only be used for educational or scientific purposes according to the HUMMUS repository README.
Repository code is licensed under GPLv3 according to the HUMMUS repository README.

sampling_strata.collapse_logic: full strata used; sparse strata receive deterministic minimum floors when feasible
sampling_strata.sparse_strata_collapse: full protein/sodium/calorie/rating cross-product removed from allocation key and recorded as diagnostics
